cards.front: Recall a key point about Copland and British Orchestral Music
cards.back: Copland's style features open harmonies (wide-spaced chords), sparse textures, and folk-derived melodies — his Americana sound defines mid-20th century US orchestral music.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Copland and British Orchestral Music
cards.back: British composers combined pastoral tradition with modernism: Britten's dramatic orchestration, Tavener's spiritual minimalism, Maxwell-Davies's folk-modernist fusion.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Copland and British Orchestral Music
